# Frozen unpublished closed-compaction debris

Written on 2026-10-03 by a scratch program (not part of any change) built against `1eb9de5`, the
revision before specs/015, through the public API only. `store/` is a store of all three families,
written with a 512-byte WAL segment size so that each family has at least one sealed segment and an
active file (the key/set family has two). `staging/` holds what that revision's closed compaction
stages for it: the three active files of a closed compaction of a copy of `store/`, which are the
staged files renamed into place. Copied together as `store/` and `.store.pigment-compact.next/`
beside it, with no manifest, they are what a closed compaction killed after its staging write and
before `Prepared` leaves. Opened so by `1eb9de5`, each family answers `AuthorityUndetermined` and
keeps the staging.

These files are compatibility inputs (specs/015 FR-3, fifth review): an open must remove the
staging because it is byte for byte what a closed compaction of the canonical directory stages,
which holds only while the snapshot encoder writes the bytes `1eb9de5` wrote. They must not be
regenerated by the implementation under test.

The data are chosen so that the order in which the encoder writes keys, set members and map
entries decides the bytes (specs/015, final review, which regenerated the fixture with the same
procedure before it was first committed: in the first version every key of a family had one
length, and every set one member, so an encoder writing keys or members in another order passed
the test). In each family the keys' order by length differs from their byte order; a set and a
map hold several members or entries, of different lengths, in more than one key.

Logical contents (the histories include overwrites, deletes, a duplicate set append, a member
removal, a map entry removal, multiple outer keys and an empty value):

- key/value: `aardvark=first`, `alpha=one`, `b=bee`, `empty=[]`, `gamma=three`, `zz=last`; `beta`
  absent;
- key/set: `group={a-long-member, b, red}`, `other={x}`, `zz={m1, m22}`; `blue` removed from
  `group`;
- key/sorted-map: `book={1:one, 3:three}`, `other={7:seven, 9:nine}`, `zz={5:five, 6:six}`;
  `book`'s entry `2` removed.

The writes, in order, in each family: key/value `alpha=uno`, `beta=two`, `alpha=one`, remove
`beta`, `empty=[]`, `gamma=three`, `zz=last`, `b=bee`, `aardvark=first`; key/set append to `group`
`red`, `blue`, `red`, remove `blue`, append to `group` `a-long-member`, `b`, to `other` `x`, to
`zz` `m22`, `m1`; key/sorted-map `book` entries 1, 2, remove 2, 3, `other` 7, 9, `zz` 6, 5.
